answer: A voyage is a buyer-funded service lot, not a key-based reward. Its anchor is a signed prepaid escrow; a prism rule divides it into one verified delivery payment and a nonrefundable audit fee. Proposed validators consume the lot ID once and deny unfunded or replayed claims. A farm can share a model and borrow cash to self-buy lots, but it only recovers its own deposits minus fees. Each additional profitable identity needs another external buyer budget; loans cannot manufacture that demand.
